info.description: Safalife API is a comprehensive backend service for Safalife's competition management system. This API provides endpoints for health monitoring, user management, competition tracking, and administrative functions. Built with Go using Clean Architecture principles, it offers high performance and reliability for managing large-scale competitions.
info.title: Safalife API
